¡Bienvenidos a la primera competencia organizada en colaboración con CETis 156, "CETis 156 Broncos 2025"! Nos entusiasma anunciar esta competencia, la cual se llevará a cabo de forma completamente gratuita. Nuestro objetivo es incentivar a los alumnos de CETis 156 a descubrir y participar en el fascinante mundo del speedcubing.

*Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.*

Welcome to the first competition organized in collaboration with CETis 156, "CETis 156 Broncos 2025"! We are excited to announce this competition, which will be completely free of charge. Our goal is to encourage CETis 156 students to discover and engage with the fascinating world of speedcubing.

*This event is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to the competition.*

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1piIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d29197442f9c0cca01548d66ec5476309b322c33/EN.png)

This competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

**Note:** This competition is aimed towards more experienced competitors. If you haven't competed before then you are welcome to do so, but we recommend choosing out a more beginner-friendly competition which has the standard 3x3x3 event. **This competition does NOT have a 3x3x3 event!**

For more information, please check the tabs!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2RiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--94ed0fe65a7490a7d754bd5102bbf816e502a7be/SI.png)

Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

**Opomba:** To tekmovanje je namenjeno bolj izkušenim tekmovalcem. Če še niste tekmovali, ste prav tako dobrodošli, vendar vam priporočamo, da izberete začetnikom bolj prijazno tekmovanje, ki ima klasično disciplino 3x3x3. **Na tem tekmovanju NI discipline 3x3x3!**

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegaMentalBreakdown2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.

items.information:
Welcome back for a third rendition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering.
 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

Even though on-the-spot registration is enabled, do not count on this! If the competition fills up, we won't be able to accept on-the-spot registrations, even if competitors do not show up. If you are able, we very much appreciate you registering in advance to save us time and effort, and save you some money!
